schema.description: `ACTIVE <-> SUSPENDED`. Only a SUSPENDED carrier is refused when it books; an unregistered SCAC is accepted.
schema.title: CarrierStatus

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 100); anything else is 400 `invalid-limit`. A query parameter the collection does not declare is 400 `unknown-query-parameter`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token, copied from the previous page's `nextCursor`; absent for the first page. A value that does not decode is 400 `invalid-cursor`. Repeat the filters on every page request.
